conclusion.information_term: Dead against the posited opponent: an honest hedger holding the pool prior recovers everything at >=3000 iterations despite verified persistent uncertainty.
conclusion.design_consequence: The metapool program reduces to matrix-Nash mixing over distinct-signature teams (the H0 branch of the prereg): prior fixed-point machinery, weighted candidate beliefs, and signature-variant generation are cut from the main-run plan. Mixing's value (M8 +0.077 vs counter-picking) stands - and the envelope shows WHY mixing matters: committed reads bleed, so never commit; hedge (which the blind machinery already does).
